inbox.text: An agent has been in touch about Finn Jeltsch, who is 19 and has a year left. The desk prices a new deal at £7.2m up front on 40k a week for 4 years. Say nothing and he can talk to anyone in the summer.
One of your defenders is selling his own brand of protein cereal in the players lounge. another of the senior lads reckons it tastes like drywall.
A reporter from the local paper is running a piece on whether this squad is good enough for what the board have asked of you. He wants a line from you before it goes out.

decisions.text: The squad's fines kitty has £100k in it from late arrivals and phones in meetings. The head coach asks where it should go. The local paper always runs it when it goes to charity.

options.label: Give it to the club's community partner (press mood +2)
Put it in the transfer pot (£100k into the transfer budget)
Leave it in the kitty (nothing changes)
